auth.forgot: Forgot the password? Over SSH on the router run: nfqws2-flowseal password off

update.title: Update the build?
update.description: The latest build is downloaded from GitHub and installed. nfqws2 restarts, this page may reload.

password_off.title: Turn the password off?
password_off.description: Anyone on your home network will be able to open this page and change the settings.

strategy.help: A strategy is a set of Flowseal bypass techniques: fake packets, splitting requests, swapping the site name. Providers block things differently, so if a site or Discord voice does not work, try the strategies one by one. ALT11 is the default.
strategy.ts_help: The fakes of this strategy need TCP timestamps. Phones, Macs and Linux have them on; Windows has them off by default. Turn them on in an administrator console: netsh interface tcp set global timestamps=enabled. Without them the fakes are skipped and only the other techniques work.
strategy.approx_help: Approximate translation: zapret2 has no altorder mode for hostfakesplit, the usual order is used.
strategy.interface_help: The router port the internet comes through. It is detected on install.
strategy.rules_help: How many iptables rules send traffic to nfqws2. 0 means nothing is processed.
strategy.busy: The router is busy with an update or another change, try again in a minute.

devices.title: Devices
devices.help: Which home network devices nfqws2 processes. Access policies are created in the router web interface: Connection priorities → Internet access policies, where devices are added to them too. The provider connection must be ticked in the policy.
devices.no_policies: The router has no access policies. Create one in the router web interface: Connection priorities → Internet access policies.
devices.now_only: Only devices from the policy "{{name}}" are processed now.
devices.now_except: All devices except the policy "{{name}}" are processed now.
devices.not_applied: The policy "{{name}}" is not on the router, so all devices are processed.

lists.personal_help: These lists are yours: only you change them, build updates never touch them.
lists.readonly: Read-only: these lists are replaced when the build is updated.
lists.saved: Saved. nfqws2 picks up the list by itself, no restart needed.

user.title: Sites
user.help: Your domains to apply the strategy to, one per line. Subdomains are included; ^ at the start of a line means this domain only. Works together with the Flowseal list-general.

exclude.title: Exclusions
exclude.help: Domains that must not be touched even if they are in other lists, for example sites that break with the bypass.

ipset.title: IP addresses
ipset.help: IP addresses and subnets for the Flowseal by-IP profiles, one per line, for example 1.2.3.0/24. Such traffic is processed without checking the site name.

ipset_exclude.title: IP exclusions
ipset_exclude.help: IP addresses and subnets that must not be touched.

list-general.title: Sites
list-general.help: The main Flowseal list: Discord, Cloudflare, DNS services and more.

list-google.title: YouTube
list-google.help: Google and YouTube sites: the strategies have a separate profile for them.

list-exclude.title: Exclusions
list-exclude.help: Sites Flowseal never touches: banks, government services, Yandex and others.

ipset-exclude.title: IP exclusions
ipset-exclude.help: Local networks that are never processed.

ipset-all.title: IP addresses
ipset-all.help: The Flowseal IP list. It holds a placeholder 203.0.113.113/32, like the IPSet none mode in Flowseal: nothing is processed by IP.

log.help: What the build did last: install, update, strategy changes.

settings.password_help: Protects this page. It is a separate password for this interface only, not the router one. If you forget it, run over SSH on the router: nfqws2-flowseal password off
settings.password_off: No password: anyone on your home network can open this page.
settings.updates_help: New builds bring tested Flowseal strategies and lists. The nfqws2 engine is frozen and is updated only together with the build.
settings.check_failed: Could not check: GitHub is unreachable
settings.engine_held: frozen, updated only with the build

update.title: Updating the build
update.failed: The update finished with an error, see the log above.
update.available: Build {{version}} is available, update it from the menu
